beta_stability.method: agreement of the beta estimate across the two halves of the 180d window

beta_strength.method: positive OLS beta against BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P + BINANCE:ETHUSDT.P + BINANCE:SOLUSDT.P, scaled so beta 2.0 reads 100

factor_r2.method: multivariate OLS with intercept on BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P + BINANCE:ETHUSDT.P + BINANCE:SOLUSDT.P

independence.method: derived as 100 - factor_r2 by the builder

liquidity.method: cross-sectional percentile of mean daily turnover over 30 sessions
